_howto: The shared route. Edit on a laptop, push, then hit 'Load shared route' in the app. Building ids come from the name, so reloading keeps history. Walking order matters. 'units' can stay empty when you count bags by floor instead of by door.

_sections: The property splits into two sides. Section 1 is everything walked before the second compactor run; section 2 is the rest. Dumping at a section boundary beats dumping mid-section even with room left.
_capacityNote: Full-truck readings so far: 83, 96. Bag volume varies, so the low end is the safe planning number and the spread is the real story — a 'full' truck is anywhere in that range depending on bag size.
